messages.ko: 벌써 알피투어가 끝이 났다니이 이제 알피조합과 무대를 못본다는 생각에 슬프기도하고 무대중간에 웨이브들이 전하는 너무 감동적인 영상을 봐서 그런가 후유증이 쎈 무대였어 ㅠㅠ 많은 도시 다니면서 이 셋리스트와 멤버조합 그리고 항상 같이 다니시던 직원분들 열정적이고 귀여운 웨이브들까지 그 모든 공기를 다 담고싶었어 내 기억속엔 선명하게 남겠지만 더이상 느끼지 못할거라는 생각에 너무 아쉽고 더 즐길걸 잘할걸 싶다 ㅠㅠ 빠른시일 내에 투어가 있을지도 모르지만(나도 모름) 그땐 내가 가지 않을수도 있으니까 오늘 마지막 공연에서 뭔가 애틋했어 ㅋㅋㅋ 그래도 무사히 투어를 끝냈으니까 한편으론 후련하기도 하다! 과거의 내가 일기에 적어놓은 내용중에 넌 곧 투어를 갈텐데 잘 하고있니 실력은 더 늘었니 이런 내용이 있는데 이제 답 해줄 수 있을것같아ㅏ
messages.en: I can't believe the Alphie tour has already come to an end. Thinking that I won't get to see this Alphie lineup and stage anymore makes me sad, and maybe because I watched the incredibly touching video that WAVs prepared during the performance, this stage left such a strong aftereffect on me. ㅠㅠ As we traveled through so many cities, with this setlist, this member lineup, the staff who were always with us, and even the passionate and adorable WAVs, I wanted to hold onto every bit of that atmosphere. It'll stay vivid in my memories, but knowing I won't be able to experience it anymore makes me regret not enjoying it even more and not doing even better. ㅠㅠ There might be another tour soon (I don't know either), but I might not even be part of it, so today's final performance felt especially sentimental. ㅋㅋㅋ Still, since we finished the tour safely, I also feel relieved. In my old diary, I once wrote, 'You'll be going on tour soon. Are you doing well? Have your skills improved?' I think I can finally answer that now.
I really think being on stage is something wonderful.

messages.ko: 웨이브들의 응원과 사랑을 두눈으로 볼 수 있고 내가 보여주고싶은걸 잘 보여줄수있는 공간이니까
messages.en: It's a place where I can see WAVs' love and support with my own eyes, and where I can show everything I want to show.
I want to stay on stage for a very long time, and I want to keep seeing you for a very long time too...
What were you doing just now~?
I've been coming so late these days, haven't I?
It's because I missed you~
If you're tired, go to sleep.
Just read what I sent tomorrow.
Today I did dumpling buns.
How was it?
Since it'll probably be my last concert while I'm still 19.
I wanted to try it.
Do you like it when I'm cute?
I'm not a cute character though. ㅋ
You're a chic, elegant, sexy, cute character.
That's exactly right.
Airport behind-the-scenes.
Taking my contacts out as soon as I got on the plane.
Honestly, you just bought the exact same glasses again, didn't you?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
No, I didn't.

messages.ko: 얼굴은 동글동글 동구라민데 안경은 네모네모싸인인게 너무 긔여움
messages.en: Your face is so round, but your glasses are all square, and that's so cute.
My face is already so round that if my glasses were round too...
That won't do.
But...
I trusted what **Y/n** said and ate whatever I wanted.
Now I've become such a pig.
I like pigs, so it's okay.
That's... a good thing, right?
But do I really look okay?
Don't I look too puffy?
I'm honestly shocked.
Actually...
When I gain weight...
It doesn't go to just one part.
It happens all over.
It's like an extra layer gets added over my whole body.
So I don't even realize I'm gaining weight.
And by the time it's noticeable, it's already too late.
What day of your diet is it now? Day one?
It's always Day 1. ><
...You're so skinny that I want to make you a seven-course meal...
Then I'd probably eat everything in front of me.

messages.ko: 괜찮아 그냥 하연이면 다 좋아 귀여워서 좋고 사랑스러워 🫶
messages.en: It's okay. As long as you're Hayeon, I love everything. You're cute and lovable. 🫶
And just like that, Hayeon ends up eating again...
Hehehe!!!!
**Y/n** told me to eat more!!!!!
Hehehehehe.
Oh, Hayeoni.
What did you just say?
You said Haseok...?
So that's Haseok's image—so warm and cozy.
Ttirori.
Seriously though, there's a photo I really want to send you.
I look so cool in it.
It's one where I'm wearing rimless glasses.
But it hasn't been approved yet.
So I can't show it.
Ttirori.
Ttirori.

messages.ko: 보여주고 하연이가 혼나자 다수가 행복한 방향이 맞아
messages.en: Show it and let Hayeon get scolded—the option where the majority is happy is the right one.
Mm-hmm... is that how it is?
I'll wait for the right opportunity.
And send it someday.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
But if you secretly send it and we all keep quiet about it, wouldn't nobody know?
You wouldn't keep quiet though~ ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Hayoi isn't a fool.
You'd immediately make it your profile picture.
"Hayeon sent me this!! But it's a secret!!!"
That's exactly what you'd do.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I seriously can't fall asleep...
Because of me?
Because you're thinking about me so much that you can't sleep?
Hm?
You can't work either.
You can't study either.
Is it really like that?
I knew it~

messages.ko: 너 설마 노리고 일상생활 못하게 한거야?
messages.en: Wait... did you do that on purpose so I couldn't function in daily life?
Of course~
So you're really a bad kid? Is being pretty all it takes?
That's my charm.
Sneaking in before you realize it and making it impossible to escape. ㅋ
Whoa... like a vi...rus? Something like that?
Mm... yeah, I guess so.
It's like having a chronic cold.
You just end up living with it.
Oh, kind of like a keychain.
Let me become a keychain...
Please let me.
**Y/n**'s honorary keychain.
Since you're a keychain, does that mean I have to carry you on my bag every day?
I'll endure that much dizziness.
Can't I just put you on my head like Ratatouille?
Only on days you've washed your hair. ㅋㅋ
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
My flight is in a few hours.
I should get some sleep.
Sleep well.
Next time I'll come a little earlier.
Haranghae. 😍🫠
